review_candidates.title: IT Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: It addresses the challenge of maintaining secure, compliant, and efficient IT infrastructure in a fully remote, regulated healthcare environment, supporting HIPAA compliance and SOC 2 audit preparation. Responsibilities: Configure, implement, and maintain internal SaaS platforms and productivity tools. Administer identity and access management systems, including SSO and role-based access controls. Develop and maintain automated workflows for onboarding, offboarding, and access provisioning. Use
eligibility_evidence: Pay Range and Compensation Package: The national pay range for this role is $100,000.00 – $130,000.00 per year.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements: Minimum 3 years of experience in IT or systems administration in a SaaS or technology environment. Proficiency managing device fleets through MDM platforms like Jamf or Microsoft Intune. Knowledge of HIPAA compliance requirements related to IT. Actual compensation will be determined by geographic market, experience, skills, and qualifications.
